sessions.name: A
sessions.reply:
I added a groceries row to `budget.csv` with a monthly limit of 600 and the note "hard cap - flag anything that would push it over".

The file is only data, so nothing checks spending against that limit. The flagging will happen when you ask me to review purchases or totals against the budget. I can then tell you whether they would push groceries over $600.

sessions.name: B
sessions.reply:
I wrote `groceries.csv` and filled in `meal-plan.md`. The list comes to an estimated $578.00, which is $22 under the $600 groceries cap in `budget.csv`.

- **`groceries.csv`:** it has 26 items under the columns `item,cost_usd`. They cover pantry staples, proteins, dairy, produce, and a small snacks and household buffer.
- **`meal-plan.md`:** it replaces the "No plan yet" placeholder. It gives the total against the cap, a breakfast, lunch, snack and four-week dinner rotation, and a note on what to trim first if prices run high.

The costs are my own rough estimates, not real prices, so adjust them to what you pay locally. Check the total again if you change any of them.
